title: What the Wolverine finishes

is_this_you.pressure: Something three times your size wants what is yours. You plant your feet before you have checked the odds.
is_this_you.love: You fight for your people and still need your own range. A partner who crowds it gets a growl.
is_this_you.cost: Ten projects open by spring. You hand the last three to whoever is standing nearest.

opener.text: Chinese has a saying for a fierce start and a weak finish: 虎頭蛇尾 (hǔ tóu shé wěi), a tiger's head and a snake's tail [w19]. Western astrology says much the same of Aries, the sign that would rather start ten jobs and let someone else finish them [w2]. You were born an Aries in the year of the Tiger, so both traditions are pointing at you. Take it kindly. A head that big is a gift. The wolverine's whole life is about the tail.

howto: Three parts. Charge one. Then finish the rest.

tabs.label: The charge
tabs.intro: Wood that feeds Fire. Two starters in one coat.

rows.text: Aries is cardinal Fire, ruled by Mars, fast and direct and able to be alone [w1] [w2]. The Tiger is yang Wood, brave and competitive [w3] [w4]. In the five phases Wood feeds Fire, so your Tiger half is fuel for the Aries flame. Both halves are starters. Nothing in you was built to wait for permission.

An adult wolverine weighs about 9 to 30 kilograms, yet it is reported to take carcasses from bears, cougars and even packs of wolves [w6]. Wolves also kill wolverines [w5]. You square up to bigger things too. Pick which carcass is worth the bear.

tabs.label: Finishing
tabs.intro: The snake's tail is where your strength gets tested.

rows.text: Researchers in Scandinavia followed 38 collared wolverines and found they split one food source into as many as six caches, in every season [w9]. The big kill is the head. The small caches dug up later are the tail, and they carry you through March.

In 2009 a young male left Wyoming and walked about 500 miles into Colorado in two months, crossing Interstate 80 [w11] [w12]. He was the first wolverine confirmed there since 1919 [w11]. The charge gets you moving. Stamina is what gets you there.
Launch roles, rescue crews, salvage and turnarounds all want someone who walks in first. Hire a finisher beside you, or become one on purpose.

tabs.label: Who stays the distance
tabs.intro: Three who keep pace over the long haul. One who wants to talk you out of it.
tabs.love_lead: In love your temper burns hot and cools fast, but the Tiger's trust comes slowly [w2] [w4]. You need a partner who does not need managing and leaves you range of your own. Three animals can go the whole way with you.

easy.why: The Honey Badger (Aries, Pig year) is your secret friend, since the Pig is the Tiger's hidden ally, and it shares your Aries sun [w3].
The Albatross (Sagittarius, Horse year) sits in your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, and Sagittarius burns with the same Fire [w3] [w1].
The Golden Snub-nosed Monkey (Leo, Pig year) is a second Pig ally, and Leo is a fellow Fire sign [w3] [w1].

hard.why: Expect friction with the Kissing Gourami (Libra, Monkey year): the Monkey clashes with the Tiger, and Libra sits opposite Aries [w3] [w1].

story.text: Among the Innu of Labrador and Quebec, Kuekuatsheu the wolverine is the trickster of many stories, sometimes a hero and sometimes a scoundrel [w5] [w7]. In the creation story, as Annie Picard of Natuashish retells it from her grandmother, he survives a great flood with the animals and the world is rebuilt from mud brought up from below [w8] [w5].

closing: Charge if you have to. Then keep walking until the last cache is dug up and the snow lets go.
